name: Vansh Sharma
title: DevOps Engineer & Full Stack Developer
bio: DevOps Engineer and Full Stack Developer with hands-on experience in cloud infrastructure, CI/CD automation, and building AI-powered web applications. Currently working on Azure VM migrations, Linux server management, and production deployment automation. Proficient in containerization with Docker, MLOps pipelines, and integrating Generative AI (Gemini, RAG) into modern web interfaces. Passionate about designing secure, scalable, production-ready architectures and solving complex data problems through intuitive dashboards.

highlights: 1st Place Winner in two University-Level Hackathons (CTF & Python/OpenCV challenge)

experience.description: Migrated an on-premises backend application to an Azure Virtual Machine, ensuring successful deployment and service continuity. Automated backend application startup and monitoring using systemd services on Linux. Configured and managed Linux server environments for backend workloads. Assisted in improving deployment reliability and operational stability. Worked closely with backend and infrastructure components in a production-like environment.

Delivered full-stack web applications for diverse clients using the MERN Stack (MongoDB, Express, React, Node.js), ensuring responsive and user-friendly designs. Collaborated with cross-functional teams to streamline release cycles using Git branching strategies, reducing code conflicts by 20%. Managed web hosting environments and deployed client applications, ensuring high availability and rapid troubleshooting of production issues.

projects.name: Deepfake Detection & MLOps System (VoiceGuardAI)
projects.description: Architected an end-to-end MLOps pipeline for a custom AI media verification platform. Built a FastAPI-based inference API with endpoints for health checks and deepfake detection via URL or file upload. Integrated a pre-trained Hugging Face model deployed externally on the server for independent model updates. Created a lightweight Next.js/HTML frontend for real-time deepfake analysis. Containerized the entire workload with Docker and implemented a fully automated GitHub Actions CI/CD workflow that runs PyTest tests, builds Docker images, pushes to Docker Hub, and deploys automatically to DigitalOcean via SSH with zero manual steps.

projects.name: FinSight - AI-Powered Bank Statement Analytics
projects.description: Architected a modern fintech dashboard that automates financial tracking by transforming bank statement PDFs into actionable insights. Integrated Google Gemini 2.5 Flash to parse and categorize complex transaction data. Built a secure backend using Supabase (PostgreSQL + Auth) for Google OAuth and encrypted passwords for PDF. Developed an interactive frontend with TypeScript and Recharts to visualize spending trends, deployed via Docker on Railway.

projects.name: AI Portfolio RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation)
projects.description: Engineered a conversational portfolio site that uses RAG to allow recruiters to chat with a 'virtual version' of my professional profile. Implemented an in-memory vector store using cosine similarity to retrieve relevant JSON context (skills, experience) for the Gemini API. Designed a premium 'Glassmorphism' UI using shadcn/ui and Framer Motion, featuring real-time streaming responses for a seamless user experience.

achievements: 1st Place Winner in two University-Level Hackathons (CTF & Python/OpenCV challenge)
